title: Happy Birthday, Jodi!
excerpt: Grace and I have four amazing adult kids, all (for the moment) in their twenties. (We also have a wonderful son-in-law and daughter-in-law, and 1.5 cherished grandchildren.) Today is the birthday of our younger daughter, Jodi, on the right in the picture.
